_note: Standardized taxonomy (categories + common technical functions). This file holds NO manufacturer technical values. Short descriptions are generic definitions of the function concept, not brand-specific facts.

categories.name: Motor & Electrical Configuration
functions: Nameplate voltage of the connected motor, entered so the drive can model the motor.
Nameplate full-load current of the connected motor; commonly used for motor overload protection.
Nameplate frequency of the connected motor.
Nameplate output power of the connected motor.
Nameplate speed of the connected motor at rated load.
Nameplate power factor (cos φ) of the connected motor.
Magnetizing / no-load current of the motor.
Upper limit of drive output voltage.
Lower output voltage point of the V/f characteristic, where documented.
Upper limit of drive output current.
Setting that scales motor overload capability or protection level.
Number of motor poles used for speed calculation.
Procedure in which the drive measures motor electrical constants.

categories.name: Frequency Configuration
functions: Lowest output frequency allowed during operation.
The maximum frequency defines the upper frequency limit allowed by the drive.
Frequency at which the drive reaches rated output voltage in V/f operation.
Upper clamp applied to the frequency reference.
Lower clamp applied to the frequency reference.
Fixed frequencies selected through digital inputs.
Frequency bands avoided to prevent mechanical resonance.
Output frequency used during jog operation.
Frequency at which output starts when a run command is given.

categories.name: Acceleration & Deceleration
functions: Time for output frequency to ramp up, per the manufacturer's reference definition.
Time for output frequency to ramp down, per the manufacturer's reference definition.
Rounding of the ramp at start/end of acceleration and deceleration.
Deceleration time used for emergency or fast stop.
Ramp times used in jog mode.
Selection between ramp stop and coast stop (or others).

categories.name: Operation & Command Control
functions: Selects where start/stop/direction commands come from (keypad, terminals, communication).
Switching between local (keypad) and remote control.

categories.name: Frequency Reference & Input Sources
functions: Selects where the frequency reference comes from.
Frequency reference set from the operator panel.
Voltage analog input used as a reference.
Current analog input used as a reference.
Pulse-train input used as a frequency reference.
Frequency reference written over serial communication.

categories.name: Torque & Motor Control
functions: Voltage boost at low frequency to increase torque.
Raises output frequency with load to compensate motor slip.
DC current injected into the motor to brake / hold.

categories.name: Protection & Fault Management
functions: Electronic thermal protection of the motor.
Limits current/voltage during accel, decel or run to avoid trips.
Response to excessive DC bus voltage.
Response to low supply / DC bus voltage.
Detection of input or output phase loss.
Detection of ground fault on output.
Automatic reset and restart after a fault or power loss.

categories.name: Digital & Analog I/O
functions: Function assigned to a multi-function digital input.
Function assigned to a relay or digital output.
Signal assigned to an analog output.
Gain, bias or scaling of analog inputs.

categories.name: Modbus RTU / RS485 Communication
functions: Selects the serial protocol / data format.
Node address of the drive on the RS485 network.
Time after which loss of communication is detected.
Drive action when communication is lost.
Function codes supported by the drive.
Register written to start/stop/reverse/reset the drive.
Register written with the frequency reference.
Register reporting drive running / fault / ready state.
Register reporting the current fault code.
Documented rule mapping parameter numbers to register addresses.

categories.name: Advanced Configuration
functions: Switching frequency of the output PWM.
Sleep and wake functions, commonly with PID.
Compensation of output voltage for supply variation.
